one_liner: Proxy that bridges Claude Max subscription to OpenCode via Agent SDK PreToolUse hook interception, preserving multi-model routing.
key_insight: PreToolUse hook + maxTurns:1 interception pattern enables Claude Max subscription proxying to third-party IDEs while preserving multi-model agent routing. Validates Claude Max arbitrage strategy (18-36x cost advantage). 223 bookmarks vs 162 likes (1.38:1 ratio) signals strong practitioner save-for-later intent.

comparison_notes.vs_cc_mirror: CC Mirror brings other models INTO Claude Code UX; this proxy takes Claude Max subscription OUT to OpenCode. Opposite direction, same arbitrage motivation.
comparison_notes.vs_litellm: LiteLLM is a general model router/proxy; opencode-claude-max-proxy is specifically a Claude Max subscription bridge. LiteLLM addresses the 378x pricing spread, this addresses the subscription-vs-API cost gap.
comparison_notes.vs_our_setup: We use Claude Code natively with Claude Max — no proxy needed. But the PreToolUse hook interception pattern is reusable for building custom routing layers.
